entities.blurb: A log or stem is a naturally occurring block found in trees or huge fungi, primarily used as a building block and to create planks, a versatile crafting ingredient. There are currently ten types of logs: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak and poplar; and two types of stems: crimson and warped.
entities.name: Poplar Log

entities.blurb: Planks are common blocks used as building blocks and in crafting recipes. They are usually one of the first things that a player crafts in Survival mode. There are currently 13 variants of planks, which can be differentiated into three categories: Overworld planks made from tree logs, bamboo planks made from blocks of bamboo, and nonflammable Nether planks made from huge fungus stems.
entities.name: Poplar Planks

entities.blurb: A wooden pressure plate is a wooden variant of the pressure plate. It can detect all entities, producing the maximum signal strength of 15. Wooden pressure plates come in all variants of wood.
entities.name: Poplar Pressure Plate

entities.blurb: A sapling is a non-solid block that can be grown into a tree.
entities.name: Poplar Sapling

entities.blurb:
A shelf is a block that can store and display up to three stacks of items. Using an item slot exchanges its contents with the player's hotbar. Powering a shelf combines its three slots together and makes using it swap everything at once.
Two or three adjacent shelves can merge their slots together if all are powered, which allows for swapping six or nine items at a time, respectively.
entities.name: Poplar Shelf

entities.blurb: A sign is a non-solid block that can display text, and can be placed on the top or side of other blocks. The text of signs can be customized with dyes and glow ink sacs, and they can be waxed to prevent its text from being edited by any player.

entities.blurb: Potent sulfur is a  block made from sulfur that produces noxious gas, which gives Nausea temporarily, if placed beneath shallow water. entities.blurb: Powder snow is a non-solid block found in snowy slopes and groves, or collected from snowfall using cauldrons. It slows down and deals freezing damage to most entities within it. Wearing any leather armor prevents freezing, while wearing leather boots allow powder snow to be walked on and climbed through. It can only be obtained using a bucket and melts when placed inside water.
entities.name: Powder Snow

entities.blurb: A cauldron is a block that can contain water, lava, or powder snow and, in certain situations, collect them from the environment. In Bedrock Edition, it can also hold dyed water or potions and can be used to efficiently create tipped arrows. It also serves as a leatherworker's job site block.
entities.name: Powder Snow Cauldron

entities.blurb: A powered rail is a type of rail that either increases or halts the velocity of minecarts depending on its power state, and can be used to accelerate a minecart from a standstill when placed facing a conductive block.

Pumpkin seeds are items obtained from pumpkins that can be used to grow pumpkin stems.
Pumpkin stems are plants grown on farmland that, over time, grow pumpkins on dirt, mud, and moss blocks adjacent to them.
entities.name: Pumpkin Stem

entities.blurb: A banner is a block that can be crafted in 16 different colors, customized in a loom using dyes and banner patterns, and applied to a shield. In Java Edition, banners can also be used to add markers to maps.
entities.name: Purple Banner

entities.blurb: A bed is a dyeable utility block that allows a player in the Overworld to sleep through the night and change their spawn point to within a few blocks of the bed, as long as it is not broken or obstructed. Villagers sleep in beds at night and require spare beds to produce offspring.
entities.name: Purple Bed

entities.blurb:
A candle is a dyable block that emits light when lit with a flint and steel. Up to four of the same color of candle can be placed in one block space, which affects the amount of light produced.
Dyed candles are the dyed variants of candles that come in all sixteen colors. Once dyed, they cannot be changed into a different color.
entities.name: Purple Candle

entities.blurb:
A cake is a block that can serve as food. It can be eaten by placing and using it, with each use consuming one of its seven slices. The entire cake gives the most hunger points out of every food item, but has low saturation.
A cake with candle is an uneaten cake with any type of candle placed on it, which can be lit with a flint and steel to emit light.
entities.name: Cake with Purple Candle

entities.blurb: Carpets are thin variants of wool that can be dyed in any of the 16 colors.

entities.blurb: Concrete slabs are a craftable slab variant of concrete. They come in 16 colors.

entities.blurb: Concrete stairs are a craftable stair variant of concrete. They come in 16 colors.
entities.name: Purple Concrete Stairs

entities.blurb: Glazed terracotta is a vibrant solid block that comes in the sixteen regular dye colors, obtained by smelting stained terracotta. Glazed terracotta does not stick to slime blocks or honey blocks, and it cannot be pulled by sticky pistons, but it can be pushed by pistons.
entities.name: Purple Glazed Terracotta

entities.blurb: A shulker box is a dyeable block that stores items, and, unlike all other storage blocks, keeps its contents in item form when broken.

entities.name: Purple Stained Glass Pane

entities.blurb: Stained terracotta is a dyed variant of terracotta obtained by crafting undyed terracotta with dyes. Some of the variants are found in badlands biomes, and all variants can be smelted into glazed terracotta.

entities.name: Red Shrub

entities.blurb: A shulker box is a dyeable block that stores items, and, unlike all other storage blocks, keeps its contents in item form when broken.
entities.name: Red Shulker Box

entities.blurb: Stained glass is a dyed variant of the glass block.
entities.name: Red Stained Glass

entities.blurb: A stained glass pane is a dyed version of a glass pane. It is a transparent block that can be used as a more efficient alternative to stained glass blocks.
entities.name: Red Stained Glass Pane

entities.blurb: Stained terracotta is a dyed variant of terracotta obtained by crafting undyed terracotta with dyes. Some of the variants are found in badlands biomes, and all variants can be smelted into glazed terracotta.
entities.name: Red Terracotta

entities.blurb: Flowers are plants that occur in a variety of shapes and colors. Many of them can be crafted into various types of dye and/or suspicious stew, and some have unique properties. Bees collect nectar from most flower types, which they use to fill their home nests and hives with honey. Additionally, most flower types can be used to breed bees.
entities.name: Red Tulip

entities.blurb: A banner is a block that can be crafted in 16 different colors, customized in a loom using dyes and banner patterns, and applied to a shield. In Java Edition, banners can also be used to add markers to maps.
entities.name: Red Wall Banner

entities.blurb: Wool is a block obtained from sheep that can be dyed in any of the sixteen different colors. It can be used as a crafting material and to block vibrations.
entities.name: Red Wool

entities.blurb: A wool slab is a craftable slab variant of wool. It can be dyed in all 16 colors.
entities.name: Red Wool Slab

entities.blurb: Wool stairs are a craftable stair variant of wool. They can be dyed in all 16 colors.
entities.name: Red Wool Stairs

entities.blurb: A block of redstone, internally known as a redstone block, is a mineral block equivalent to nine redstone dust. It acts as an always active redstone power source that can be moved by pistons.
entities.name: Block of Redstone

entities.blurb: A redstone lamp is a solid block that produces light while it is receiving redstone power.
entities.name: Redstone Lamp

entities.blurb:
Redstone ore is the ore block from which redstone dust is obtained.
Deepslate redstone ore is a variant of redstone ore that can generate in deepslate and tuff blobs.
entities.name: Redstone Ore

entities.blurb: A redstone torch is a non-solid block that produces a full-strength redstone signal on all sides adjacent to it, except for its attached block, and can power the block directly above it. It deactivates while the block it is attached to is powered.
entities.name: Redstone Torch

entities.blurb: A redstone torch is a non-solid block that produces a full-strength redstone signal on all sides adjacent to it, except for its attached block, and can power the block directly above it. It deactivates while the block it is attached to is powered.
entities.name: Redstone Wall Torch

entities.blurb:
Redstone dust (often just called redstone) is a mineral used in crafting, brewing, and trimming, as well as being used as a placeable wire.
Redstone wire is a non-solid block that can transmit a redstone power signal up to 15 blocks in distance; signal strengths below 15 have reduced distance. Redstone wire can power blocks it is placed on or pointing at.
entities.name: Redstone Wire

entities.blurb: Reinforced deepslate is a block that generates exclusively in ancient cities. It has the highest hardness of any block, is immune to explosions, and cannot be pushed by pistons or obtained in Survival mode.
entities.name: Reinforced Deepslate

entities.blurb: A redstone repeater is a block that produces a full-strength redstone signal from its front while its back is powered, with four toggleable delay settings. It can also be locked into its current power state by directly powering its side with another repeater or a redstone comparator.
entities.name: Redstone Repeater

entities.blurb:
A command block is an indestructible block that can execute commands. Because it cannot be obtained, destroyed or used in Survival mode without cheats, it is primarily used in multiplayer servers, Creative worlds, and custom maps. There are 3 types of these blocks.
An impulse command block is the default block type; it executes only once when activated.
A chain command block executes every time when triggered.
A repeating command block executes every game tick as long as it is activated.
entities.name: Repeating Command Block

entities.blurb: A block of resin, internally known as a resin block, is a block equivalent to nine resin clumps. It acts as a good temporary block being broken instantly without having any special properties, and can be used to craft creaking hearts.
entities.name: Block of Resin

entities.blurb: A resin brick slab is a decorative slab variant of resin bricks that does not generate naturally and is used for building.
entities.name: Resin Brick Slab

entities.blurb: Resin brick stairs are a decorative stairs variant of resin bricks that do not generate naturally and are used for building.
entities.name: Resin Brick Stairs

entities.blurb: A resin brick wall is a decorative wall variant of resin bricks that does not generate naturally and is used for building.
entities.name: Resin Brick Wall

entities.blurb: Resin bricks are a block crafted from resin brick. It can also be crafted into its block family, containing slabs, stairs, walls, and the chiseled variant.
entities.name: Resin Bricks

entities.blurb: A resin clump is a block generated by a creaking heart on pale oaks in any biome when a creaking is attacked. It also drops when a creaking heart is mined or destroyed. It can be used to craft decorative blocks of resin, and can also be smelted to produce resin bricks, which in turn can be crafted into the whole resin brick block family.
entities.name: Resin Clump

entities.blurb: The respawn anchor is a block that allows the player to set their spawn point in the Nether, provided it's fueled with glowstone blocks.
entities.name: Respawn Anchor

entities.blurb: Rooted dirt is a natural decorative block.
entities.name: Rooted Dirt

entities.blurb: A rose bush is a tall flower that can be crafted into red dye.
entities.name: Rose Bush

entities.blurb: Sand is a gravity-affected block found abundantly in deserts and beaches, and less commonly in or near surface water.
entities.name: Sand

entities.blurb: Sandstone is a solid block related to sand that comes in two color variants, the other being red sandstone. Regular sandstone is commonly found in deserts and beaches. Sandstone also has three decorative variants: chiseled sandstone, cut sandstone, and smooth sandstone.
entities.name: Sandstone

entities.blurb: A sandstone slab  is a decorative slab variant of sandstone that generates in desert structures and is used for building.
entities.name: Sandstone Slab

entities.blurb: Sandstone stairs are a decorative stairs variant of sandstone that generate in Overworld structures and are used for building.
entities.name: Sandstone Stairs

entities.blurb: A sandstone wall is a decorative wall variant of sandstone that generates in desert villages and is used for building.
entities.name: Sandstone Wall

entities.blurb: Scaffolding is a climbable semi-solid block with a stable top platform and unique placement controls that simplify creating columns and bridges. Scaffolding pieces fall downward if placed too far away from a supporting block, which can naturally form into more supporting columns.
entities.name: Scaffolding

entities.blurb: Sculk is a block found abundantly in the deep dark or converted from other blocks by a sculk catalyst. Like most of the rest of the sculk family, it drops experience when broken by a tool.
entities.name: Sculk

entities.blurb: A sculk catalyst is a sculk block that "blooms" when a mob or player dies nearby, which may convert nearby blocks to sculk blocks (except for other sculk catalysts).
entities.name: Sculk Catalyst

entities.blurb: A sculk sensor is a sculk block that detects vibrations caused by nearby actions and events and emits a redstone signal in response. Player-caused vibrations can also trigger nearby sculk shriekers. Sneaking prevents the creation of vibrations while moving, and wool can be used to block or prevent them. Placing an amethyst block next to a sculk sensor allows it to "relay" detected vibrations to other sculk sensors.
entities.name: Sculk Sensor

entities.blurb:
A sculk shrieker is a sculk block that "shrieks" if any player touches its top (even indirectly) or activates a nearby sculk sensor. Only players can trigger it. 
Naturally-generated sculk shriekers appear only in the deep dark biome. They also inflict Darkness and may summon a warden if triggered, but shriekers placed by players or sculk catalysts are completely inert and harmless.
entities.name: Sculk Shrieker

entities.blurb: A sculk vein is a block found in the deep dark or generated by sculk catalysts. It can generate or be placed on any side of a solid block.
entities.name: Sculk Vein

entities.blurb: A sea lantern is an underwater light source that appears in ocean monuments and ocean ruins. It has an animated pulsing texture.
entities.name: Sea Lantern

entities.blurb: A sea pickle is a block found in warm oceans. While in water it emits light, and can be spread using bone meal if placed on a living coral block. Up to four sea pickles can be placed in one block space, which affects the amount of light produced while in water.
entities.name: Sea Pickle

entities.blurb:
Seagrass is a non-solid plant block that generates underwater in most aquatic biomes.
Tall seagrass is a two-block high variety of seagrass.
entities.name: Seagrass

entities.blurb: A shelf mushroom is a fungus that grows on poplar trees. It has two sizes and causes entities to bounce when they fall on it.
entities.name: Shelf Mushroom

entities.blurb: Short dry grass is a one-block tall foliage block that generates frequently in deserts and all types of badlands. It grows on sand and terracotta. It can also be eaten by sheep.
entities.name: Short Dry Grass

entities.blurb: Short grass is a non-solid plant block that may drop wheat seeds when broken. Its color is biome-dependent, and matches the color of grass blocks.
entities.name: Short Grass
